initialExam.title: UPSC CMS (Combined Medical Services) 2026
initialExam.description: Combined Medical Services examination for recruitment of doctors in government hospitals, railways, and ESI. Exam scheduled August 2026.
initialExam.eligibility: MBBS Degree with completion of internship
initialExam.syllabus: Paper-I: General Medicine & Pediatrics (120Q). Paper-II: Surgery, Gynaecology, Preventive & Social Medicine (120Q).
initialExam.examPattern: Paper-I: 120 questions, 250 marks, 2 hours. Paper-II: 120 questions, 250 marks, 2 hours. Interview: 100 marks.
initialExam.jobRole: Medical Officer in Central Health Service, Railways, NDMC, ESI
initialExam.careerGrowth: Medical Officer → Senior Medical Officer → CMO → Director General.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit upsc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Upload medical degree documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: NPA (Non-Practicing Allowance), DA, HRA, Medical, Government quarters
